premises: Force-constant disorder in HEAs strongly impacts anharmonic phonon scattering and lattice thermal conductivity.
Ab initio lattice dynamics with explicit anharmonicity can decouple lattice and electronic heat transport.
Lattice thermal conductivity in HfNbTaTiZr is weakly temperature-dependent from 300 to 1200 K.
Earlier Debye- or DFT-based analytical estimates conflate lattice and electronic contributions and show larger errors.
The proposed model will reduce prediction errors by roughly 20% compared to previous methods.
